params.permit: Permit2 batch for the ERC-20 sides (spender: this factory). Pass an empty signature to use        plain approvals instead.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

feeBpsFor(address).notice: The protocol fee this user pays on earnings: the base fee, less the staking discount (The Well)         and the invitee discount (first months after joining through a link).

keeperStale().notice: True once the keeper has been silent for longer than the grace period: then anyone may trigger a         due range move or reinvest (still fully checked by the vault).

openPosition((address,address,uint24,int.notice: Opens a position in one transaction: creates the pool if asked, creates the caller's vault, links an         invite code for first-time wallets, moves the tokens straight from the wallet into the vault (Permit2         signature, plain approvals, or native BNB for the WBNB side) and opens the range.

recordKeeperAction().notice: Vaults record keeper activity; keepers can also check in directly.

setPaused(bool).notice: Emergency stop. The guardian (admin Safe) acts immediately; the timelock can too.
